decision_notes: The affected vulnerability range and the assessed static Trigger rule both cover <2.5.0. Existing upstream advisory, OSV, release, fix-commit, API History, and curated Trigger evidence support the condition in which urllib3.PoolManager is constructed with retries=0 and the resulting receiver invokes urllib3.PoolManager.request. The controlled positive and negative regressions preserve the same API-to-Version and vulnerability-exposure context: both retain S_api >=1.9 and 81 exposed releases, while changing only the producer retries literal from 0 to 1 causes the Trigger match and Risk Card candidate to disappear. requires_untrusted_input remains a semantic precondition; a static Trigger match does not prove attacker-controlled input or exploitability.
